chain.title: Moonlight Pulled From Stone
chain.desc: Smelted from Silver Ore or Raw Silver; nearly every witch's tool in the mod is forged from it.

chain.title: The Blade That Cuts Spirit
chain.desc: Silver and flint. It strips bark from logs, fills taglocks, and shears heads from the mobs it kills.

chain.title: It Screams When Pulled
chain.desc: Grown from Mandrake Seeds on tilled soil; the root binds the Book of Shadows and the Druid Band.

chain.title: Open the Grimoire
chain.desc: A plain book bound with Mandrake Root, opening chapters on brewing, rituals, curses, poppets, sigils and contracts.

chain.title: Where the Power Pools
chain.desc: Stone, bark and silver. The altar gathers magical power from the nature around it and pays for every ritual you cast.

chain.title: A Name Sealed in Glass
chain.desc: Bone and a glass bottle, filled by striking a creature with an Athame; it aims a ritual at one specific target.

chain.title: Set the Brew Boiling
chain.desc: A vanilla Cauldron rebuilt with bark and silver; it brews the mod's forty-eight potions by colour.

chain.title: What the Fire Leaves Behind
chain.desc: Logs cooked on a campfire; the binding agent in every stick of chalk.

chain.title: Draw the First Circle
chain.desc: Cobblestone, Wood Ash and bark. It marks the Glyph rings that every ritual must be performed inside.

chain.title: The Circle's Beating Heart
chain.desc: Silver, iron bars and nether wart, set at the centre of the circle to consume the ritual's reagents.

chain.title: Blood of the Ground
chain.desc: Distilled from Aconite, Spruce Bark and stone; the first of six oils that the advanced chalks demand.

chain.title: The Gilded Ring
chain.desc: Chalk quenched in Cleansing Balm and Earth Ichor, drawing the golden circle most rituals require.

chain.title: Something Is Loose in the Nether
chain.desc: Hellhounds prowl the Nether and are the earliest reliable source of Demon Horn.

chain.title: Taken From a Burning Skull
chain.desc: Dropped by Hellhounds and by every greater demon; the summoning ritual will not run without one.

chain.title: A Circle Drawn in Embers
chain.desc: Chalk cut with Fiery Serum and Heaven Extract; the demon summoning needs it for both the inner and the outer ring.

chain.title: Answer the Summons
chain.desc: The Summon Demon ritual costs 666 altar power and burns a diamond, Snake Tongue, Demon Horn, Aconite and Belladonna.

chain.title: Still Warm, Still Beating
chain.desc: Dropped by Demons, Baphomet, Herne, Leonard and Lilith; it powers the familiar binding and the Voodoo Poppet.

chain.title: A Cold Spot in the Room
chain.desc: Ghosts are the mod's only source of Ectoplasm.

chain.title: Residue of the Restless
chain.desc: A ghost's leavings, used in the Specter Bangle, the Sentinel Sigil and the ritual that binds a familiar.

chain.title: A Doll Wearing Your Enemy's Name
chain.desc: Aconite, a Demon Heart, dried kelp, a hay block and vine; paired with a Taglock it passes your wounds to another.

chain.title: Lines That Should Not Meet
chain.desc: Chalk mixed with Aqua Cerate and Grim Elixir; the outer ring of the binding and divination rituals.

chain.title: Sign, and Be Paid
chain.desc: A pact carrying one of fifteen named terms from Lust to Treachery, each granting a boon while its days run down.

chain.title: The Goat Upon the Throne
chain.desc: Baphomet is summoned by ritual and drops the Caduceus alongside Demon Hearts and Demon Horns.

chain.title: The Serpent-Wound Rod
chain.desc: Baphomet's own staff, and the rarest thing the mod will let you carry out of a ritual circle.

notes: VERIFICATION: 239 ids pass the strict test (models/item stem INTERSECT item./block. lang key). Chalk and the 12 sigils fail that intersection because their display names are composed at runtime from block.bewitchment.glyph / block.bewitchment.sigil plus a variant key (chalk.bewitchment.*, sigil.bewitchment.*), but all 16 are registry-verified as crafting recipe RESULTS, which is stronger evidence than a lang key; including them gives the 255 usable ids reported. DROPS: the 6 *_variant model files (horned_spear_variant, nazar_variant, prickly_belt_variant, taglock_variant, waystone_variant, witch_hat_variant) are alternate model files with no registry reference, not items. Of the 197 lang-only keys, almost all are '<colour>_<material>_witch_altar' cloth blockstate variants of the nine real altar items, plus book_of_shadows.landing_text; only 'mandrake' had any registry reference (the crop block, whose item is mandrake_root). ENTITIES: 23 entity.bewitchment.* lang keys; 13 verified killable against data/bewitchment/loot_tables/entities/ (baphomet, demon, ghost, hellhound, herne, leonard, lilith, owl, raven, snake, toad, vampire, werewolf). Dropped 10 that would produce uncompletable kill tasks: horned_spear and silver_arrow (projectiles) and the 8 boat/broom vehicles. GRAPH: rituals are data-driven (25 bewitchment:ritual_recipe files); each declares an 'inner' and 'outer' chalk type plus an altar power 'cost', so chalk tier is the real gate - summon_demon requires fiery/fiery at cost 666 and bind_familiar requires fiery/eldritch at 850. The six oils come from bewitchment:oil_recipe and each needs a bark that only the Athame can strip, which is why the Athame is placed second. demonic_contract has no recipe and no loot table; it is granted through demon interaction in code and stores its named term (contract.bewitchment.*, 15 of them) as NBT rather than as 15 item ids, so it cannot be expanded into a wheel. CONSENSUS: all 26 moddb ids exist in the jar and no ordering contradiction was found - moddb's early cluster (garlic, saplings, book_of_shadows, athame, taglock at pos 0.10-0.20) and its late cluster (poppets, grim_elixir, aqua_cerate at pos 0.33-0.48) both agree with the recipe graph. One minor divergence: moddb ranks book_of_shadows at pos 0.123 but never ranks mandrake_root, which its recipe requires; the graph is preferred and mandrake_root precedes it here.
